purpose: Compare admissible same-bar resolution families before freezing one policy. Decision support only; must not be used to tune toward a preferred OOS result.

policies.definition: Use verified finer-granularity trade-path evidence when available to establish SL/TP touch order.
Apply one identical precedence to every ambiguous bar, independent of outcome, fold, future information, or performance.
For ambiguity, account for the adverse exit first.
For ambiguity, account for the favorable target exit first.

selection_constraints: Do not select by maximizing win rate, return, or another OOS performance metric.
Do not inspect OOS outcomes to choose the policy.
Do not use future information, fold identity, or candidate performance as a tie-breaker.
Selected policy must be deterministic and frozen before OOS.
If raw trade ordering becomes verifiable before freeze, it may replace an assumed precedence only through a separately reviewed evidence update.

decision_boundary.next_action: Select and freeze one explicit policy, then run fail-closed CI before OOS.

note: No policy is recommended or selected by this audit.
